descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Service Center Manager is responsible for supervising a team of technical professionals in delivering field service engineering support to customers. This role ensures the effective execution of service operations, resolves complex technical issues, and maintains high levels of customer satisfaction. The manager plays a key role in setting team goals, managing performance, and ensuring compliance with service standards. Main accountabilities and tasks 1. Managing, Planning & Ensuring the timely & Quality repairs of Rotary Equipments received at Service Center for Repair. 2. Complete ownership of service center operations ensuring the Growth of service center by systematic & professional approach by controlling all the activities & process of service center. 3. Responsible for monthly/ Yearly RFC targets defining and accomplishments as per commitment. 4. Responsible & ensuring the repairs process is being executed as per standard & quality process. He Should be capable for taking decisions in making any changes in process for better results. 5. Responsible for maintaining the Customer confidence in service center by On time delivery with reduced order cycle time with no compromise in quality. 6. Modify layout if requires, improvise the process if requires by implementing the lean and good industrial practices. Work experience : 15+ years' Experience in rotary equipment repair service & can handle the team of 10 -15 members. Education
• Qualifications Degree or Diploma in mechanical Engineering Languages: Tamil / Hindi / English Soft skills : 1. Micro soft Office/ SAP/ Operational applications Like Service center Dashboard/ Qlick sense/ Zest application 2. Good Communication skills. Interdepartmental interactions. What we offer you 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays Defined contribution pension scheme Hospitalization insurance benefit On-site car parking Long service award Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
